promptText: Which soft brand or collection hotel brands should an owner consider for affiliation while preserving the hotel’s individuality?

payload.rawResponseText:
Here is a comprehensive guide to the **soft brand and collection hotel brands** that an owner should consider when seeking affiliation while preserving their hotel's individuality:

---

## 🏨 Soft Brand & Collection Hotel Brands for Independent Hotel Owners


Soft brands, which generally debuted in the late 2000s and took off in the 2010s, have become very popular with owners and travelers alike as a way for independent hotels to affiliate with major chains.
 
They are designed to offer "the best of both worlds: individuality plus the commercial engine of a major brand."


---

### 🔷 I. MAJOR CHAIN SOFT BRANDS (Franchise-Based)
These are soft brands offered by the world's largest hotel companies. They provide access to powerful loyalty programs, global distribution, and marketing — while allowing the hotel to retain its own name and character.

---

#### 1. **Marriott International**

Marriott features the **Autograph Collection** (launched 2010), **Tribute Portfolio** (2015), and **The Luxury Collection**.
 
Marriott also launched its sixth soft brand in September 2025 — the **Outdoor Collection by Marriott Bonvoy**.
 Additionally, 
**Design Hotels** is part of Marriott's portfolio, with properties such as Hotel Granada Midtown in Atlanta joining the collection.
 
Each Design Hotels property is design-driven and defined by "a unique creative vision."


---

#### 2. **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**

Hilton features the **Curio Collection** (2014) and **Tapestry Collection** (2017).
 
Hilton also has **LXR Hotels & Resorts** for luxury independents.
 
Hilton unveiled its 25th brand — a soft brand called the **Outset Collection** — targeting upscale independents.
 
Joining Curio, for example, provides owners access to a loyal, engaged audience actively seeking out Hilton hotels.


---

#### 3. **Hyatt Hotels Corporation**

Hyatt's soft brands include its **Independent Collection** portfolio, which comprises **Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, and **JdV (formerly Joie de Vivre)**.
 
These collections "retain a specific property name, as well as a unique design and orientation toward their local community."


---

#### 4. **IHG Hotels & Resorts**
IHG has been particularly active in the conversion and soft brand space. 
The **Vignette Collection**, IHG's Luxury & Lifestyle conversion brand launched in 2021, is ahead of its goal to reach 100 hotels in a decade, with 26 open and 41 pipeline hotels.
 
**Voco**, IHG's versatile premium conversion brand, has already exceeded 100 open hotels across almost 30 countries.
 
IHG recently unveiled the **Noted Collection**, a premium collection brand aimed squarely at converting independent upscale and upper upscale hotels that want the firepower of IHG's distribution platform without giving up their identity, with the company expecting to sign more than 150 hotels over the next decade.


---

#### 5. **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts**

Wyndham places two brands in the soft-brand category: the upper-midscale **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** and the upscale/luxury **Registry Collection Hotels**.


---

#### 6. **Accor**

Accor's soft brands include **Emblems**, **MGallery**, and the **Handwritten Collection** — showing the major player feels a need for soft brands at multiple price points.
 
Properties such as Hotel Maison Maastricht Centrum – Handwritten Collection demonstrate how individual concepts can integrate seamlessly into Accor's global systems while preserving their individual identity.


---

#### 7. **Choice Hotels International**

Starting with the launch of the **Ascend Hotel Collection** by Choice in 2008, Choice pioneered the soft brand concept.
 
Ascend is a major growth engine for Choice outside of the United States.


---

#### 8. **BWH Hotels (Best Western)**

From economy to luxury, BWH Hotels offers **SureStay Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection**, and the four **WorldHotels Collection** brands — WorldHotels Luxury, Elite, Distinctive, and Crafted — all of which offer independent hoteliers the freedom to maintain their unique identity while benefiting from BWH Hotels' robust support systems, including an award-winning loyalty program, global sales and marketing reach, and advanced revenue management tools.


---

### 🔶 II. INDEPENDENT HOTEL CONSORTIA & NETWORKS
These are member-based organizations — not franchise arrangements — that give independent hotels a global distribution platform and prestige while allowing maximum operational freedom.

---

#### 9. **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**

Preferred Hotels & Resorts has spent the past five years expanding its portfolio in an increasingly crowded luxury space, and represents more than 600 independent properties. Its loose-touch model offers hotels a way to tap global distribution networks without the long-term commitments, higher costs, or confusing brand proliferation that come with a major chain's portfolio.


---

#### 10. **The Leading Hotels of the World (LHW)**

The Leading Hotels of the World is a member-owned network, booking platform and commercial services organization for more than 425 independent luxury hotels in over 80 countries. It gives distinctive hotels the reach of a global brand through sales, distribution, marketing, loyalty, quality assurance, technology and strategic sourcing, while allowing owners to preserve the identity and operating independence that made their properties worth visiting.


---

#### 11. **Relais & Châteaux**

Relais & Châteaux is an exceptional worldwide collection of 580 unique, independently operated hotels and restaurants, united by strong values and a devotion to excellence across every aspect of hospitality.
 
Founded in 1954 as a chain of French roadside relais, Relais & Châteaux gathered intimate properties — manor houses, country inns, vineyard estates, and, uniquely, standalone restaurants.


---

#### 12. **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)**

Small Luxury Hotels of the World consists of over 520 intimate and privately owned hotels, many of which have been managed and owned by the same family for generations.
 
SLH prides itself on personalized service tailored to every customer's specific needs, with hotels offering a smaller number of rooms and a private, intimate setting.


---

### 📊 Summary Comparison Table

| Brand/Collection | Parent Company | Segment | Key Benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Autograph Collection | Marriott | Upscale–Luxury | Bonvoy loyalty, global distribution |
| Tribute Portfolio | Marriott | Upper Upscale | Flexibility, Bonvoy rewards |
| The Luxury Collection | Marriott | Luxury | Prestige, global reach |
| Design Hotels | Marriott | Lifestyle/Upscale | Design-driven identity |
| Outdoor Collection | Marriott | Upscale | Nature/adventure focus |
| Curio Collection | Hilton | Upscale–Luxury | Hilton Honors loyalty |
| Tapestry Collection | Hilton | Upscale | Personality-driven hotels |
| LXR Hotels & Resorts | Hilton | Luxury | Ultra-luxury positioning |
| Outset Collection | Hilton | Upscale | New, targets independents |
| Unbound Collection | Hyatt | Upscale–Luxury | World of Hyatt loyalty |
| Destination by Hyatt | Hyatt | Upscale | Local community focus |
| JdV by Hyatt | Hyatt | Lifestyle/Upscale | Boutique lifestyle identity |
| Vignette Collection | IHG | Luxury | Fast conversion, premium |
| Noted Collection | IHG | Premium/Upscale | Newest, upscale independents |
| Voco | IHG | Premium | Rapid global expansion |
| Trademark Collection | Wyndham | Upper Midscale | Approachable flexibility |
| Registry Collection | Wyndham | Upscale–Luxury | Luxury independents |
| MGallery | Accor | Upscale–Luxury | Lifestyle storytelling |
| Handwritten Collection | Accor | Midscale–Upscale | Character-driven properties |
| Ascend Hotel Collection | Choice Hotels | Upscale | Pioneer soft brand, strong global reach |
| WorldHotels (4 tiers) | BWH Hotels | Upscale–Luxury | Multi-tier, identity preserved |
| Preferred Hotels & Resorts | Independent | Luxury | Loose-touch, 600+ properties |
| Leading Hotels of the World | Independent | Luxury | 400+ properties, 80+ countries |
| Relais & Châteaux | Independent | Luxury | Intimate, curated, culinary focus |
| Small Luxury Hotels (SLH) | Independent | Luxury | Family-owned, intimate properties |

---

### 💡 Key Takeaway

The upper upscale and upscale conversion space is increasingly crowded, and the pitch to owners is essentially the same everywhere: **"Keep your name, get our distribution."**
 
Aligning with network brands has become critically important for many smaller operators, offering an alternative path to autonomy with global scale and, in many cases, access to a broader loyalty program.
 The best choice ultimately depends on the hotel's segment, geographic footprint, desired level of autonomy, and budget for any property improvement plan (PIP) requirements.
